mode: Separate deterministic publication from checked handoffs
scope: Model publication from checked Markdown handoffs. Selected annual observations, exact quarter windows and conditional scenarios remain separate. Source tables are literal; selected annual values use the existing Decimal helpers. Operating EBIT plus cash-flow D&A is distinct from issuer ordinary and As Defined EBITDA. Cash after capex is a proxy, carrying debt is not all claims and reported cash is not certified accessible liquidity. No analytical rerun, Excel output or native accepted head. Charts show selected annual history only; retained conditional calculations, when supplied, remain unchanged.
